text:
sam (Partnerships): Quick update  Sapphire Systems went live on the Marketplace this morning with our ISV connector and signed a 1-year dedicated capacity deal. 🎉 https://marketplace.example/sapphire-redwood

marketplace-bot: Listing status: PUBLISHED. region: us-central1. partner_id=SAPPHIRE-404.

elaine (Sales): Love it — can someone share pilot perf highlights we can put in the announcement?

juan (Solutions): Pilot summary: latency improved by ~35% for their document-classification pipe after we enabled batching + prefix cache. P95 went 450ms -> 290ms. Also enabled quantization for the embedder to fit within their GPU footprint.

tia (Product): Great — can we get a 1-line quote from their Head of AI and a screenshot for marketplace? Elaine, can you collect the quote?

elaine (Sales): Reached out to Maya at Sapphire, she said she'll send a short quote by EOD.

sam (Partnerships): Confirming this counts toward co-sell. I'll file the paperwork and publish a short case note in the partner portal once quote arrives.

juan (Solutions): Ops snippet for case appendix (internal):
```
deployment: dedicated
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 15
caching:
  prefix_kv: true
quantization: int8
```

sam (Partnerships): Thanks team — small follow-ups: 1) Elaine get quote, 2) Juan paste final perf numbers, 3) Tia draft marketplace blurb. ETA 48h for public assets. :rocket:
